definitions.short: Dibon , the name of three places in Palestine
definitions.full: H1769. Dibon דִּיבוֺן דִּיבֹן, proper name, of a location — 1 city in Moab (MI 21; 28 דיבן , compare ib. 1 adjective, of a people הדיבני ) — דִּיבֹן Num 21:30 ; 32:3 , 34 (built up or at by Gad) Isa 15:2 ; in territory of Gad, hence גָּד֑ דִּיבֹן Num 33:45-46 , (compare on these verses & 32:34 MI 10f. ); also דִּיבוֺן Josh 13:9 , 17 ; Jer 48:22 ; דִּיבוֺן בַּת ישֶׁבֶת 48:18 ; = דִּימוֺן Isa 15:9 , see also דִימוֺן מֵי 15:9 = Arnon, compare Che & Hpt ZA 1887, 268 ; — modern Dîbân , north of Arnon, compare Seetzen :Reisen i. 409 Tristr Land of Moab 132 ff. Bd Pal 193 . 2 דִּיבֹן Neh 11:25 place in Judah, toward south = דִּימוֺנָה Josh 15:22 , compare Hpt l.c .; conjectures by Kn Ke (compare Di) to be Tell ed Dheib (van de Velde Mem. 252 ) called also Ehdeib (Rob BR ii. 102 ). דַּיָּג דִּיג, see below דגה . דַּיָּה see below דאה . דְּיוֺ see below דוה .
